Ghana Street Games — realistic asset sources
Checked 31 October 2026. Listed media assets are CC0 1.0 / public domain.
CC0 terms: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

CHARACTERS
CharacterCreator generated output by Kasper Olesen / kblood, built from MakeHuman CC0 system assets.
https://github.com/kblood/CharacterCreator
Specific licence for generated body, hair, clothing and animation data:
https://github.com/kblood/CharacterCreator/blob/master/LICENSE-NOTES.md#generated-files-owner-decision-2026-10-03
The generator/runtime source code is GPL; none of that code is included in this game.
athlete-body.glb: base_body_anim.glb derivative; customization morphs removed, skinning and 12 clips preserved; matching authored _CCZONE clothing-coverage attribute transferred from base_body.glb.
athlete-shirt.glb, athlete-shorts.glb, athlete-shoes.glb: corresponding clothing GLBs with customization morphs removed.
athlete-hair.glb, athlete-afro.glb: hair_short04 / hair_afro01 with customization morphs removed.
The game applies its own kit and skin colour choices. No real person's likeness is claimed.
Original source files and licence evidence are retained in research/asset-sources/characters in the source repository.

PBR MATERIALS — Poly Haven
https://polyhaven.com/license
Dry Ground 01 — Rob Tuytel — https://polyhaven.com/a/dry_ground_01
Red Dirt Mud 01 — Rob Tuytel — https://polyhaven.com/a/red_dirt_mud_01
Plastered Wall 02 — Charlotte Baglioni — https://polyhaven.com/a/plastered_wall_02
Corrugated Iron 02 — Jenelle van Heerden (processing), Sergej Majboroda (photography) — https://polyhaven.com/a/corrugated_iron_02
Wood Planks — Amal Kumar — https://polyhaven.com/a/wood_planks
Downloaded diffuse, OpenGL normal and roughness maps at 1K resolution. These are generic surface materials, not scans of a named Ghanaian location.

LIGHTING — Poly Haven
Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy (Pure Sky) — Greg Zaal (original), Jarod Guest (sky edits).
https://polyhaven.com/a/kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky
lighting/daylight.hdr is the 1K HDR edition. It is a lighting reference; no Ghanaian capture location is claimed.

RECORDED AUDIO
football-kick.mp3 — Soccer Ball Kick, bittermelonheart — https://freesound.org/people/bittermelonheart/sounds/555042/
footstep-dirt-1.mp3, footstep-dirt-2.mp3, footstep-dirt-3.mp3 — Footsteps_Gravel_01.wav, BenDrain — https://freesound.org/people/BenDrain/sounds/488075/
The three footstep files are 0.45-second mono excerpts starting at 7.11, 16.48 and 20.82 seconds, with short fades, encoded at 96 kb/s.
handclap.mp3 — HandClap10.wav, bastianpusch — https://freesound.org/people/bastianpusch/sounds/493712/
whistle.mp3 — Referee whistle sound.wav, Rosa-Orenes256 — https://freesound.org/people/Rosa-Orenes256/sounds/538422/
The Freesound files use the publicly available HQ MP3 preview encodings, under each recording's CC0 dedication.
applause.mp3 — Applaudissements #1, Dorian CLAIR — https://lasonotheque.org/applaudissements-1-s2363.html
outdoor-ambience.ogg — AMB Outside 1, Kresiek The Furry — https://opengameart.org/content/amb-outside-1
The ambient recording is generic outdoors, not claimed to have been recorded in Ghana.

KENNEY FOLEY
footstep_grass_000.ogg, footstep_grass_001.ogg, footstep_concrete_000.ogg, footstep_wood_000.ogg,
impactGeneric_light_000.ogg, impactSoft_medium_000.ogg, impactWood_light_000.ogg.
Kenney Impact Sounds — https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds — CC0.
Publisher download returned HTTP 403 during acquisition; original CC0 samples obtained from this mirror:
https://github.com/GeorgeQLe/assets-sfx-combat/tree/main/assets/kenney/impact-sounds

No Four Corners GH models, recordings or other proprietary media are included. It remains a visual/gameplay reference.

Game scene previews
JPEG previews are rendered from the game’s own Three.js scenes. Underlying character, material and lighting credits are listed above.

Pampanaa pretend-play mouth call: OBXJohn, Laser Gun Pew Pew (Freesound 365635), CC0; trimmed mouth-sound excerpt, mono MP3. Generic licensed voice effect, not a Ghana field recording.
Source: https://freesound.org/people/OBXJohn/sounds/365635/
